text: This staff report is about a matter for which Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision, provided that it is not amended so that it varies with City policy or by-laws. Transportation Services is requesting North York Community Council to authorize the installation of an accessible parking space on the north side of Woburn Avenue, west of Elm Road. The installation of an accessible parking space will address the needs of a local resident, while reducing the available on-street parking by one space.

North York Community Council: 1. Designated an accessible parking space to operate at all times on the north side of Woburn Avenue, between a point 36.4 metres west of Elm Road and a point 5.5 metres further west.
